bāheti.cp: vah + e. keeps away; wards off; removes.

C: bāheti：[vah + e] keeps away; wards off; removes．
P: Bāheti，<sup>2</sup> [Caus．of bahati4，cp．Sk．vāhayati] to carry，see sam° （sambāhana，meaning rubbing，stroking）．Whether atibāheti belongs here，is doubtful．（Page 487）

Bāheti，<sup>1</sup> [Caus．of bahati3 or denom．fr．bahi] to keep away，to keep outside，to ward off; only with ref．to pāpa （pāpaka） to keep away （from） sin S．I，141 （bāhetvā pāpāni）; Sn．519=Nd2 464a （bāhetvā pāpakāni）; Dh．267; a popular etymology of brāhmaṇa （pāpaṁ bahenti） D．III，94 （bāhitvā，better bāhetvā，expld by panuditvā DhA．III，393; v．l．K vāh°）．-- pp．bāhita （q．v．）．See also nib°，pari°．（Page 487）

DOP: bāheti pr. 3 sg. [ poss. denom. from bahi, but cf S. bādhate; BHS bāhayati, bāheti], drives away, repels; D III 93, 26 foll. (yaṃ nūna mayaṃ pāpake akusale dhamme ~eyyāmā ti … pāpake akusale dhamme ~entī ti kho … brāhmaṇā, Ee so; Be, Se vāheyyāmā ti … vāhentī ti; Ce vāheyyāmā ti … ~entī ti); — aor. 3 pl. bāhesuṃ, D III 94, 2 ( Ce, Ee so; Be, Se vāhesuṃ); — absol. bāhitvā, bāhetvā, S I 141, 23* (~itvā pāpāni); 182, 20* (yo ’dha puññaṃ ca pāpaṃ ca ~itvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pavāhetvā) = Dhp 267 ( eds ~etvā; Dhp-a III 393, 6 : ~etvā panuditvā, Be so; Ee ~itvā; Ce ~itvā opuṇāpetvā; Se vāhetvā); Ud 4, 8* (~itvā pāpake dhamme; Ud-a 58, 21 : ~itvā ti bahi katvā, attano santānato nīharitvā, samucchedappahānavasena pajahitvā ti attho); Sn 519 (~itvā sabbapāpakāni, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ~etvā; Pj II 427, 23 : ~itvā); Mil 226, 14 (bodhiyā yeva mūle … pāpake akusale dhamme ~etvā); Pv-a 54, 3 (maraṇaṃ ~itvā, Be, Ee paṭibāhitvā); Vibh-a 262, 27 (ekaṃ iriyāpathadukkhaṃ aparena iriyāpathena ~itvā, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se bādhitvā); — pp bāhita , mfn. , driven away; repelled; prevented; M I 280, 15 (kathaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu brāhmaṇo hoti, ~ā ’ssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā); A IV 144, 24 (sattannaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ samitattā samaṇo hoti … ~-ttā brāhmaṇo hoti); Nidd I 86, 28 foll. (sakkāyadiṭṭhi ~ā hoti vicikicchā ~ā hoti …); Mil 225, 18 (sabbe mahārāja pāpakā akusalā dhammā tathāgatassa ~ā pahīnā apagatā …); Pj II 170, 29 (pāpānaṃ ~-ttā brāhmaṇaṃ); — fpp ? bāhiteyya, mfn. , M I 328, 17 (sace kho tvaṃ bhikkhu paṭhaviṃ ajjhosissasi opasāyiko me bhavissasi vatthusāyiko yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāhiteyyo; Ps II 407, 27 foll.: bāhitvā ca pana jajjharikāgumbato pi nīcataro lakuṇṭakataro kātabbo bhavissasī ti; Ps-ṭ [ Be ] II 313, 28 : bāhitvā ti nīcaṃ katvā abhibhavitvā vā); — see also pabāḷha 2 , pabāhita, vāheti ( sv vahati ).
